      • acquisitionLoop

        protected void acquisitionLoop​(RGBFrame frameBuffer)
                        throws java.io.IOException,
                               DeviceException,
                               java.lang.InterruptedException,
                               java.util.concurrent.TimeoutException
        Description copied from class: ManagedCamera
        This is the method within the acquisition loop. It should retrieve one frame from the camera, do whatever processing is necessary, then write the data into the provided Frame object ("frameBuffer"). Each time this method completes, the frameBuffer object is offered to the internal listener and queue manager, offering the frame to all attached frame listeners and queues.
        Specified by:
        acquisitionLoop in class ManagedCamera<RGBFrame>
        Parameters:
        frameBuffer - The frame buffer to dump frame data into.
        Throws:
        java.io.IOException - Upon communications error.
        DeviceException - Upon device/compatibility error.
        java.lang.InterruptedException - Upon the current thread being interruped while awaiting a new frame.
        java.util.concurrent.TimeoutException - Upon the wait for a new frame timing out.

      • cancelAcquisition

        protected void cancelAcquisition()
        Description copied from class: ManagedCamera
        This method is called alongside interrupting the acquisition thread when stopAcquisition() is called. This method should call whatever cancel/interrupt method the camera API itself provides (i.e., whatever method will cause a "wait for frame" method to return early).

        If no such method exists, leave this blank.

        If it doesn't work, it should just ignore it, so that the built-in contingencies of the stopAcquisition() method can be employed.

        Specified by:
        cancelAcquisition in class ManagedCamera<RGBFrame>
